scope: Certified (Arb) Stokes matrices at an irregular singular point of Poincare rank one in z or in a ramified variable s=z^(p/q) reached by an exact Turrittin reduction; real rational leading eigenvalues, repeated ones allowed with diagonalisable non-resonant residue blocks. Sectorial solutions enclosed by an explicit Volterra contraction bound; closed forms used only for validation.

unramified_without_closed_form.label: 2x2, A_2 term (z=0 irregular): the numerical-only system of irregular_stokes.json
2x2, A_2 and A_3 terms, non-diagonal A_0 (eigenvalues -1, 1)
3x3 Birkhoff system A_0+A_1/z, generic A_1 (not hypergeometric)
3x3 Birkhoff system, upper-triangular A_0 with eigenvalues 0,1,3
repeated eigenvalue 1 (multiplicity 2), generic residue: no closed form

ramified_and_repeated.label: Airy w''=z w (leading matrix nilpotent, exponent 3/2)
ramified_and_repeated.classical: Ai(z)+w Ai(wz)+w^2 Ai(w^2 z)=0 gives s_0=i in the normalisation z^(-1/4)e^(-+2/3 z^(3/2)); s_pi=-i from the cyclic relation

ramified_and_repeated.label: Weber w''=(z^2/4+a)w, a=0
ramified_and_repeated.classical: s_0=i sqrt(2 pi)/Gamma(1/2-a) (DLMF 12.2.18 in the normalisation z^(-a-1/2)e^(-z^2/4), z^(a-1/2)e^(z^2/4)); s_pi=-i e^(-i pi a) sqrt(2 pi)/Gamma(1/2+a)
